text: Can onboard either a brand-new company idea or an existing company and manage its ops from there
quote: Start from an idea, or bring a company you already run. AFK handles the operational busywork either way.

text: Runs core company operations (incorporation, banking, payroll, cap table) automatically in one workspace
quote: Every task — incorporation, banking, payroll, cap table — runs in the same workspace, on autopilot.

text: Lets you query and act across connected finance/HR tools (Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe) from one interface
quote: Query and act across Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe, and more from a single surface. No tab-switching, no copy-pasting between dashboards.

text: Generates a tailored operations plan based on entity type, state, and headcount instead of a generic checklist
quote: Tell us your entity type, state, and headcount. AFK builds a tailored ops plan for your actual situation, not a generic checklist.

text: AI pre-fills forms using known company/founder context, letting the user just confirm or correct
quote: AI pre-fills forms using context it already knows — your EIN, addresses, founder details. You confirm or correct.

text: Given a high-level goal, AI breaks it into concrete tasks and only asks the user for human decisions
quote: Set a goal like "Get to $1m ARR" and AI decomposes it into tasks — revenue modeling, cohort analysis, KPI alerts, milestone tracking — and asks only when it needs a human decision.

text: Read-only actions run automatically while write/cost-incurring actions pause for user sign-off with cost estimates
quote: Reads run automatically. Writes pause for sign-off. Cost-incurring actions show estimates. You control the boundary between autonomous and supervised.

text: Tasks are modeled as directed graphs with parallel branches and automatic resumption when dependencies clear
quote: Every task becomes a directed graph of steps. Parallel branches run concurrently. Blocked nodes resume automatically when dependencies clear.

text: Uses scoped OAuth tokens, encrypted secrets, automatic key rotation, and full audit logging for every action
quote: Scoped OAuth tokens, encrypted secrets, automatic key rotation, and full audit logs. Every action is traceable, every permission is minimal.

text: Provides shared company context with role-based access control and delegated approvals across the team
quote: Shared company context across your team. Role-based access controls, delegated approvals, and a single source of truth for every operational decision.
